info.title: Cartspace API
info.description:
REST API of the Cartspace storefront (Go + Gin).

- Auth uses HTTP-only cookies; browsers must send credentials.
- Request and response bodies are snake_case JSON.
- Money is always an integer amount in cents.
- Every response has `success` and `message`. Failures add a machine-readable `code`, and validation failures list `errors` with a react-hook-form style `field` path.
- Every response carries an `X-Request-ID` header (a valid incoming one is reused).

ValidationError.description: One invalid field; `field` is a react-hook-form style path such as `images.1`.

post.description: Revokes the session of the refresh token cookie, if any, and always clears the auth cookies.

Rotates the refresh token and issues a new access token. A request that lost a concurrent rotation within 30 seconds gets a new access token only. Reusing an older refresh token revokes the session. Every 401 clears the auth cookies.
